claims.evidence: One source per (arm, triple-SILAC experiment, SILAC channel) = one labelled cell population of one experiment. MaxQuant summary.txt groups the 36 SILAC raws into experiments ALK-IP-E1/E2/E3 (raw suffix A/B/C) and ALK-Phospho-E1/E2/E3 (raw MIX1/2/3). IP and phosphoproteome arms get separate source names because the deposit does not say whether they were prepared from the same cultures (paper Methods: ALK IP from 8 mg lysate per condition; phosphoproteome 5 mg per condition, acetone-precipitated). Each phospho source is measured in two injection series (rows 55-81, 82-108) under the same name; that is the same physical sample re-injected (technical replicate 1/2).

claims.value: E1: SILAC light = Crizotinib, SILAC medium = ALK Inhibitor TAE684, SILAC heavy = Dimethyl Sulfoxide; E2: light = ALK Inhibitor TAE684, medium = Ceritinib (LDK378), heavy = Dimethyl Sulfoxide; E3: light = Ceritinib, medium = Crizotinib, heavy = Dimethyl Sulfoxide
claims.evidence: PRIDE projectDescription, section "ALK Interactome and phosphoproteome": "Experiment 1: Light: 500 nM crizotinib, Medium: 100 nM TAE684, Heavy: 0.1% DMSO Experiment 2: Light: 100 nM TAE684, Medium: 250 nM LDK378, Heavy: 0.1% DMSO Experiment 3: Light: 250 nM LDK378, Medium: 500 nM crizotinib, Heavy: 0.1% DMSO", 30 min treatment. Experiment n is matched to MaxQuant experiments ALK-IP-En and ALK-Phospho-En (summary.txt) by number; the section heading applies the map to both arms. Data check (Phospho (STY)Sites.txt, normalized ratios): every quantified class-I ALK pY site (Y1078, Y1092, Y1096, Y1507, Y1584, Y1604) is lower in both light and medium than in heavy in all three phospho experiments (e.g. Y1096 log2 L/H, M/H = -2.39/-2.19, -2.18/-1.47, -1.40/-2.16; IRS2 pY632 -3.4 to -2.3), consistent with heavy = DMSO vehicle and light/medium = ALK TKIs. LDK378 = ceritinib (paper Reagents: "LDK378 (ceritinib)"). Concentrations and the 30-min duration are recorded here only (no template column). IP-arm data check (proteinGroups.txt, normalized log2 ratios, /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/a98b4c07-45f2-5d08-aa74-0c95b1e5e538/scratchpad/b10-PXD006404/ipcheck.out, script /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/a98b4c07-45f2-5d08-aa74-0c95b1e5e538/scratchpad/b10-PXD006404/scripts/ipcheck.py; same check as the independent review): known ALK adaptors are enriched in heavy over light and medium in all three IP experiments while the ALK bait is flat (ALK log2 H/L -0.29..-0.12, H/M -0.26..0.19): GRB2 H/L 3.32-3.94, H/M 3.29-3.60; PTPN11 H/L 3.03-3.61, H/M 3.01-3.69; IRS2 H/L 2.62-2.88, H/M 3.40-3.93; SHC1 H/L 2.23-2.94, H/M 2.18-2.63, so heavy = DMSO (TKI-reduced adaptor recruitment) in the IP arm too. IRS2 M/L: E1 (TAE684/crizotinib) -0.94, E2 (LDK378/TAE684) +0.65, E3 (crizotinib/LDK378) -0.95, a transitive (non-cyclic) order TAE684 < crizotinib < LDK378 under the stated map. DMSO control value: kept as "Dimethyl Sulfoxide" (NCIT:C437), deliberately deviating from campaign rule 4 ("untreated"), because the control cells received 0.1% DMSO vehicle (PRIDE, paper) and "untreated" would be false (precedent PXD020108).

claims.evidence: PRIDE: "These three triple-SILAC experiments allowed the effect of each inhibitor to be measured in duplicates"; paper: "three triple-SILAC experiments allowing us to measure the effect of each inhibitor in duplicate". Each experiment is an independent set of labelled cultures, so each inhibitor has 2 and DMSO 3 independent cultures per arm (README.adoc:330; campaign rule 3). The same numbering is used in both arms.

PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol: "gel lanes were excised and cut into 6 fractions for each experiment". summary.txt Fraction 201-205 for ALK_IP_1..5 and 206 for ALK_IP_IGG within the same experiment, so IGG is the sixth gel slice of the same lane (presumably the IgG heavy-chain region; MS/MS identification rate 6.8-7.8 %), not a separate IgG control IP.

summary.txt Fraction 301 TiO2_1st, 302 TiO2_2nd, 303 pTYR within each ALK-Phospho-En experiment: the anti-pTyr IP eluate and two sequential TiO2 enrichments of its unbound fraction are fractions of one SILAC mix (paper Methods, phosphoproteome).

Each MIX/fraction exists as two raw files (20140311_QE3_UPLC9_..._50cm_ALK_MIXn_* and 20140812_QE5_UPLC8_..._ALK_MIXn_*) that summary.txt assigns to the same experiment and the same fraction number, i.e. two LC-MS injections of the same enriched samples on different instruments. Rows 1-54: 1.

Raw headers of all 18 ALK_IP raws (20140128_QE5) and the 9 20140311_QE3 phospho raws contain "Q Exactive - Orbitrap MS" and no "Plus". PRIDE instruments field: Q Exactive. The paper says Q Exactive Plus for interactome and phosphoproteome; the raw files win and the conflict is recorded in limitations.
Raw headers of the 9 20140812_QE5 phospho raws contain "Q Exactive Plus - Orbitrap MS". PRIDE protocol: phosphoproteome on a Q Exactive Plus.

Instrument conflict: paper says Q Exactive Plus for interactome and phosphoproteome; raw headers say Q Exactive for the 18 IP raws and the 9 20140311_QE3 phospho raws, Q Exactive Plus only for the 9 20140812_QE5 raws. Raw headers annotated.

Channel map identity of the two inhibitor channels (light vs medium) rests mainly on the explicit PRIDE statement. The deposited ratios confirm heavy = DMSO vehicle in both arms (ALK pY sites decrease in L and M; GRB2/PTPN11/IRS2/SHC1 recruitment higher in H in the IP arm). IRS2 IP M/L ratios give a consistent transitive inhibitor order, compatible with but not proof of the stated map; phosphosite ratios cannot distinguish the inhibitors: correlations of inhibitor/DMSO site ratios are dominated by label (L~L 0.70-0.73, M~M 0.58-0.63) and the predicted same-inhibitor pairs (0.41-0.51) do not separate from the other cross-label pairs (0.43-0.48); IGF1R/INSR Y1161 does not give a consistent inhibitor signature. Experiment n <-> MaxQuant ALK-IP-En / ALK-Phospho-En is matched by numbering; fig. S1C (the design figure) was not retrieved.
Whether the IP-arm and phospho-arm samples come from the same SILAC cultures is not stated; they are annotated as separate sources with the same per-group replicate numbering.
Precursor mass tolerance not available: mqpar.xml is not deposited and parameters.txt lists only the MS/MS tolerance; the paper says only "default settings".
Inhibitor concentrations (crizotinib 500 nM, TAE684 100 nM, LDK378 250 nM, DMSO 0.1%) and 30 min treatment are not encoded in a column (no template column); they are in this manifest.

The single MaxQuant search combined SILAC and label-free experiments (one parameters.txt); modification parameters are those the summary.txt lists for the SILAC raws. MaxQuant enzyme rule Trypsin/P; cleavage agent annotated as the digestion enzyme(s) per campaign rule 2.
